in_sanskrit.name: Karnail
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victory Chariot
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Karnail एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Karnail is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘karna’ meaning ‘victory’ and ‘ail’ meaning ‘chariot’. This name is associated with victory, power, and strength. In Hindu mythology, Karna was a great warrior and one of the central characters in the epic Mahabharata.
